name: West Lake
kicker: The large lake in Tay Ho
summary: Trade the Old Quarter's crowds for the open water of West Lake, the large lake in Tay Ho north of the center. Walk a stretch of the shore, where pagodas and cafes sit by the water, and stop at Tran Quoc Pagoda on the way. Late afternoon is the easy time for the walk.
getThere: By car or motorbike north to Tay Ho
heroCaption: A pavilion on the shore of West Lake
gettingThere: West Lake is in Tay Ho, north of Hoan Kiem. Take a car or motorbike from the center to the shore near Tran Quoc Pagoda.
admissionNote: Check on arrival. No shore fee published.
body: West Lake is the large lake in Tay Ho, north of the center. The shore is the visit: open water, the skyline across it, and pagodas and cafes along the edge. Tran Quoc Pagoda stands on the shore with its stupa above the water.
Come in the late afternoon, after the center has had your morning. Pick one stretch of shore and walk it, with Tran Quoc as the stop.
